result.detail:
Traceability: requirement [requirement:req-837b82982d] -> interface spec [artifact:prj-c8bb158f14.interface-spec.a1] -> microarchitecture [artifact:prj-c8bb158f14.microarchitecture.a1] -> apb_gpio.v / apb_gpio_tb.v.

Assumptions written down:
(1) Only ADDR_WIDTH=8 is supported, as the spec requires. The decode uses paddr[ADDR_WIDTH-1:6], which needs ADDR_WIDTH >= 7.
(2) During a write access prdata is forced to zero, per the microarchitecture. The testbench monitor enforces this.
(3) The testbench drives inputs 1 ns after each rising edge and checks at falling edges. This is equivalent to the microarchitecture's drive-after-falling-edge plan.
(4) The testbench uses only Verilog-2001 constructs plus $error. Under Icarus it needs a SystemVerilog generation flag (e.g. -g2012); under Verilator it needs --timing or --binary.

Gap: no formal_spec was produced, so the formal.run and formal.cover requirements do not apply to this submission. The spec's section 8 formal-proof requirement remains open and should be scheduled as its own task.

The platform's lint and synth runs use the default N=8. N=32 is elaborated only by the testbench.
